items.question: Which four qualities characterize this person?
items.inference: The verse presents four linked identities of the same person.
uncertainties: jāpī is rendered as reciter rather than left untranslated.
items.plain_english: He is a sacrificer, he is pure-souled, he is a reciter, and he is a practitioner.
